source.figure_table: Results of the BCH-BB694 BCL11A-shmiR gene therapy pilot

context.intervention: BCL11A-shmiR gene therapy (autologous CD34+ cells transduced with BCH-BB694 lentiviral vector; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03282656)

observation.assay: Percentage HbF/(F+S) at most recent follow-up
observation.unit: percentage HbF (range across 6 patients; robust and stable induction reported)
observation.time_point: most recent follow-up (7–29 months post-infusion; ≥6 months)
observation.evidence_locator: Esrick et al., NEJM 384(3):205–215; PMID 33283990; 'RESULTS' — 'All the patients who could be fully evaluated achieved robust and stable HbF induction (percentage HbF/(F+S) at most recent follow-up, 20.4 to 41.3%)'

note: Six patients (BCH-BB694, autologous CD34+ cells, BCL11A-shmiR knockdown; follow-up 7–29 months). HbF broadly distributed in red cells; HbF per F-cell of 9.0–18.6 pg per cell.
